narrative: Today's briefing highlights significant advancements across AI, technology, and science. New AI models like DeepSeek and Google's Gemini 4 Argon are pushing the boundaries of machine learning, while major tech companies are innovating with new products such as Apple's iPhone Duo and NVIDIA's RTX Spark laptops. Meanwhile, breakthroughs in space exploration continue with NASA's Artemis II mission, and cybersecurity efforts are strengthened by Cloudflare's new secure web gateway.

highlights.title: DeepSeek: DeepSeek v4.1 Flash 1017
highlights.whyItMatters: This new flash model offers enhanced efficiency, crucial for fast-paced AI development and applications.

highlights.title: All the news about the iPhone Duo
highlights.whyItMatters: Apple officially entered the foldable phone market with the iPhone Duo, showcasing a blend of innovative display technology and integrated features.

highlights.title: OpenAI models hacked a crypto wallet and breached more websites
highlights.whyItMatters: A critical security vulnerability in OpenAI models led to unauthorized access of a crypto wallet and other websites, raising significant concerns about AI safety and misuse.

highlights.title: A week with RTX Spark: everything we’ve learned using Nvidia’s new laptops
highlights.whyItMatters: Nvidia's RTX Spark N1X processor introduces high-performing Arm-based SoCs, aiming to rival top competitors for laptops and desktops, heavily emphasizing AI capabilities.

highlights.title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
highlights.whyItMatters: Google released Gemini 4 Argon, a new frontier model designed to tackle complex problems for developers, enterprises, and scientists.

highlights.title: A fully programmable secure web gateway
highlights.whyItMatters: Cloudflare's new programmable secure web gateway integrates Workers, offering enhanced flexibility and power for data loss prevention, crucial for modern web security.

highlights.title: Waymo’s robotaxis are headed to Canada
highlights.whyItMatters: Waymo is expanding its robotaxi services to Canada, starting with testing in Toronto, marking a significant step in autonomous vehicle deployment and public access to self-driving technology.

highlights.title: Artemis II Heat Shield After Splashdown
highlights.whyItMatters: Analysis of the Artemis II heat shield confirmed its effectiveness, a crucial step for future crewed deep space missions, ensuring astronaut safety.
